standard_prerequisites.name: An open immersion is locally of finite type and a composite of morphisms locally of finite type is locally of finite type, both cited from the same chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that open subschemes and schemes locally of finite type over a universally catenary base are again universally catenary.

standard_prerequisites.name: The algebra lemma that over a universally catenary ring every finite type algebra is catenary
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the hypothesis on one affine chart into universal catenarity of its coordinate ring.

standard_prerequisites.name: The same-chapter characterization of locally finite type morphisms on affine charts, and the properties chapter lemma that catenarity is local on a scheme
standard_prerequisites.use: Make the coordinate rings of the chosen affine cover of X finite type algebras over the base rings, and then assemble catenarity from the pieces.

core_obligations: Show the final assertion and (1) implies (2): since an open immersion is locally of finite type and composites of locally of finite type morphisms are locally of finite type, an open subscheme and any scheme locally of finite type over a universally catenary scheme is universally catenary (proof lines 3351-3357).

Show that universal catenarity of an affine scheme makes its coordinate ring universally catenary: if Spec(R) is universally catenary then every finite type R-algebra A has catenary spectrum, so R is universally catenary; together with the previous step this gives (1) implies (3), and it also gives (2) implies (4), while (3) implies (4) is trivial (proof lines 3359-3366).

Show (4) implies (1): given a morphism locally of finite type, cover the source by affine opens each mapping into one of the universally catenary affine charts of the base, observe that the induced ring map is of finite type so the coordinate rings of the cover are catenary, and conclude by locality of catenarity (proof lines 3368-3377).
proof_roadmap: Use stability of local finiteness of type under open immersions and composition to get the final assertion and the implication from (1) to (2) (proof lines 3351-3357).

Convert chart-wise hypotheses into universal catenarity of the coordinate rings, and finish the cycle through the trivial (3) to (4) and the affine cover argument for (4) to (1) (proof lines 3359-3377).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four equivalent locality conditions for universal catenarity of a locally Noetherian scheme and adds that schemes locally of finite type over it stay universally catenary (statement lines 3335-3349). The counted proof organises the cycle of implications: it gets the final assertion and the implication from (1) to (2) from stability of local finiteness of type under open immersions and composites, converts an affine universally catenary chart into universal catenarity of its coordinate ring via the algebra lemma on finite type algebras, notes the trivial implication from (3) to (4), and closes the argument for (4) implies (1) by covering a locally finite type morphism by affine charts and invoking locality of catenarity (proof lines 3351-3377). It is H2: the proof is a well-organised reduction carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard stability and locality statements.
